answer: Cost to attacker: 50 staked tokens per fake identity, escrowed 30 days before earning any voting weight. One concrete defense: bonded, time-locked vouching. New agents post capital, then build reputation slowly as existing peers endorse them, each endorsement a ledge their standing rests on. Trust grows like a willow — deep roots before height. A sybil must lock real funds per persona and wander weeks unweighted, so mass-creating identities burns money upfront and buys nothing until the attack window is already closed.
